subject: Error in par(las = 1, col = colaxis, col.axis = colaxis, col.lab = collab,  : object 'rev.gray.colors.1' not found

messages.author: e56d0b39ee82f588
messages.subject: Error in par(las = 1, col = colaxis, col.axis = colaxis, col.lab = collab,  : object 'rev.gray.colors.1' not found
parts:
Hi folks
 
I am attempting to construct a spectrogram using the internal palette function in Seewave, and I ideally would like the colour system to be rev.gray.colors.1.  However, when I run my code the object rev.gray.colors is not found.  I can make the spectrogram with the object spectro.colors but it cannot recognise any other colour system in the pallette
 
If anyone has any ideas with how to fix this, then thank you :)
 
Kirsty
 
code:
 
#list wav files in working directory
wavs<-list.files(pattern="R2.wav")
 
#read the first audio file from 15 to 20 s
song<-readWave(wavs[1],from=15,to=20,units="seconds")
#set graph parameters
par(mfrow=c(2,1),mar=c(0,4,0,1))
 
#detect songs based on amplitude
aut.det<-timer(f.song, f=f, threshold=15,env="hil", msmooth=c(300,0),power=1.5,
               xaxt="n")
par(mar=c(4,4,0,1))
windows(width=10, height=7)

#add spectrogram
spectro(f.song,f=f.s...@samp.rate,wl=256,collevels=seq(-45,0,1),grid=F,
        scale=F,paletter=rev.gray.colors.1,flim=c(0,12))

messages.author: de80047cbc18c87e
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] Error in par(las = 1, col = colaxis, col.axis = colaxis, col.lab = collab, : object 'rev.gray.colors.1' not found
parts:
Dear Kirsty,
This is because the name of the palette has changed with the last version of seewave (a request of CRAN managers):
Try replacing rev.gray.color.1 by reverse.gray.colors.1
Best regards,
Jerome
